import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(data[0])
    tasks = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        parts = data[i].split()
        task_id = parts[0]
        priority = int(parts[1])
        tasks.append((priority, task_id))
    tasks.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])  # descending priority, stable for ties
    out_lines = [task[1] for task in tasks]
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out_lines))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
